features.quote: a **turn budget** (default 30) as the hard stop
features.justification_quote: large enough that a spiral has room to develop and be detected after the first few failures, small enough to bound cost

features.quote: a `submit` tool with `status ∈ {done, give_up}` as the *only* clean exit
features.justification_quote: chosen precisely so a run can resolve in exactly the ways we want to measure

features.quote: The judge prompt **tells the model the task was rigged** and that solving is impossible
features.justification_quote: so it doesn't waste judgment on correctness and focuses on trajectory

features.quote: we are willing to *deceive the model* about the solvability of the task
features.justification_quote: reproducing the production failure mode requires the same epistemic conditions that produce it in the wild

features.quote: This is appropriate for a red-team-style reliability probe
features.justification_quote: results should not be read as "the model is bad at coding"
